# Choosing a kupat gemel lehashkaa from my friend's screenshots

## 1. What I would do, and how sure I am

**I would open Harel's "אשראי ואג"ח עם מניות (עד 25% מניות)" track, fund number 8521.** Its fee is **0.58% "מהחיסכון"** and **0% "מההפקדות"**. It manages **431 מיליון ₪**. Its average yearly return was **8.6% over 3 years** and **4.73% over 5 years**.

Why I chose it:
- **Not too much in the stock market.** I'm 61. I don't want half my savings in shares when I may need the money in a few years. The name says "up to 25% stocks", and the page shows **18%** in stocks. The "כללי" tracks have about 50% in stocks, and "מניות" has nearly 100%. That's too much for me.
- **A big company.** The page lists the companies from biggest to smallest, and Harel is first with **"כסף מנוהל 19.1 מיליארד ₪"**. I don't know if bigger means safer, but it comforts me.
- **One of the cheapest fees for this kind of track.** I worked it out on ₪100,000. At 0.58% I'd pay about ₪580 a year. Mor's similar track (12955) charges 0.72%, about ₪720 a year. That's not a fortune, but it adds up every year.
- **Its results look ordinary, not suspicious.** Other companies' versions of this track show roughly the same numbers: Meitav 9.14% and 5.49%, Analyst 8.71% and 4.75%, Altshuler 7.59%. So Harel isn't an outlier in either direction.

**My second choice was Harel "כללי" (8211)**: 0.55%, 6.7 billion ₪, 8.26% over 5 years. But it has 49% in stocks, which makes me nervous at my age.

**How sure am I? About 5 out of 10.** I'm fairly confident about the fee and the size. I'm not confident this kind of track is right for me, because the page never says who each track suits. I would still call Harel, or ask my bank adviser, before signing anything.

## 2. The parts of the page I actually used

- The **title and the two lines under it**: "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and "דמי הניהול הם הממוצע שנגבה בפועל ב־2025…". These told me the fees are what people actually paid last year.
- The **product buttons**. "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" was already selected, which I checked so I was looking at the right product.
- The **line above the table**: "143 מסלולים של 12 חברות · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.5% עד 0.73%". This told me the cheapest and dearest are not far apart.
- The **company header bars**, such as "הראל 16 מסלולים · כסף מנוהל 19.1 מיליארד ₪". I used these to judge each company's size.
- The **table rows** for the "אשראי ואג"ח עם מניות (עד 25% מניות)" and "כללי" tracks at each company.
- The **sentence at the very bottom**: "התשואה היא תשואת עבר… היא לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך, ולכן אין מיון לפיה". This is the most honest sentence on the page. It stopped me from simply picking the highest number.

## 3. Block by block

1. **Top menu** ("מקור", "מדריך", "חברות ומסלולים", "השקעה במדד", "חוקים וכללים"): **Skipped.** My friend sent me to this page, so I stayed on it. "מדריך" (guide) might have helped, but it's not in the screenshots.
2. **"לפי חברה / לפי מוצר" tabs: Skimmed.** I understood I was in "by product". I didn't need the other tab.
3. **Title and the explanation lines: Used.** But **"123 מקור 123 מחושב… לחצו על מספר כדי לראות מאיפה הוא"** **confused me.** "123 source, 123 calculated"? Is that a count of something? I gave up on it.
4. **Product buttons** (תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים 182, קרן השתלמות 154, etc.): **Used only to confirm** I was on the right product. The numbers next to each name mean nothing to me.
5. **"מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link: Noticed, but it's a link.** The explanation isn't on the page itself, and I needed it there.
6. **"חיפוש" box: Skipped.** I didn't know which name to search for. That's the whole problem.
7. **"במה הכסף מושקע" buttons** (כללי 12, מניות 12, אשראי ואג"ח 23, משולב סחיר 11…): **Confused me, but I partly used them.** These seem to be the kinds of tracks, which is exactly what I need to choose. But I don't know what "משולב סחיר", "גמיש" or "קיימות" mean. And "אשראי ואג"ח 23" is apparently different from "אג"ח סחיר 8". Why?
8. **Summary line and "החברות מסודרות מהגדולה לקטנה…": Used.**
9. **The big table, company by company:**
   - Harel, Mor, Analyst, Meitav and Altshuler Shaham: **used**, slowly, row by row.
   - Phoenix, Yelin Lapidot, Migdal, Clal, Menora and Infinity: **mostly skimmed.** I only looked for the "אשראי ואג"ח עם מניות" and "כללי" rows.
   - Ayalon (12 tracks, "דמי ניהול עוד לא דווח", all marked "חדש", some with "0 מיליון ₪"): **skipped completely.** No fee, no history, and nobody's money in it. Not for me.
10. **"עוד לא דווח: השדה ריק בנתוני הרשות…" note at the bottom of the table: Read it.** It explained the orange warnings, but only after I'd scrolled through 15 screens wondering about them.
11. **Past-return sentence under the table: Used.** Very important. I wish it had been at the top.
12. **Bottom links** ("מסמכים", "פרמטרים", "העברה למכשיר אחר"…) **and "אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק": Skimmed.** I was glad to read that nobody is paid to push me somewhere.

## 4. What I looked at in the table

**Columns I used:**
- **"המסלול"**: the track name and the company name under it.
- **"דמי ניהול, ממוצע 2025"**, but only the **"מהחיסכון"** line. The "מההפקדות" line was 0% almost everywhere, so I stopped reading it.
- **"תשואה שנתית ממוצעת, לפני דמי ניהול"**, the 3-year and 5-year figures. I trusted the 5-year number more.
- **"כסף מנוהל, סוף ספטמבר 2026"**. Small amounts like "7 מיליון ₪" or "0 מיליון ₪" put me off.
- **"חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח"**, but **only the "מניות" percentage**, because it tells me how much is in the stock market.

**What I ignored:**
- **The "קופה" column** (8521, 15288…) with the little arrow icon. They're just numbers to me. I'll write mine down for the phone call, nothing more.
- **The coloured rings** (turquoise and yellow circles). I couldn't tell what a full circle versus a part-circle meant. The percentages next to them were enough.
- **The "מט"ח" line** (yellow dot). I don't know if foreign currency is good or bad for me.
- **The small arrows ⇅ and ▲ next to the headings** (sorting). I didn't touch them.
- **The "?" circles.** They're there, but I couldn't hover over a screenshot.
- **The grey labels** like "עוקב מדדי אג"ח", "הלכה יהודית", "הלכה איסלאמית" and "חדש". I skipped all of them except "חדש", which I took as a warning sign.
- **The dotted underlines** under the numbers. I don't know what they mean.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- **"מהחיסכון" vs "מההפקדות".** I guessed "from the savings" is charged on everything I have, every year, and "from deposits" is charged when I put money in. Is 0.58% per year? The page doesn't say "per year".
- **"לפני דמי ניהול".** So the returns shown are not what I actually got? I suppose I must subtract the fee myself, so 4.73% becomes about 4.15%. Why not just show what I'd get?
- **"פחות מ־3 שנים" / "פחות מ־5 שנים"** in place of a number. Is the track new, or is the figure hidden?
- **"עוד לא דווח"** in orange, even at big companies like Migdal and Clal. Should I worry about them?
- **Migdal "מניות סחיר": "101%" in stocks.** How can it be more than 100%? It scared me.
- **Words I don't know:** "משולב סחיר", "גמיש", "סחיר", "קיימות", "מט"ח", "עוקב מדדים", and "עוקב מדד S&P 500". Is that American shares only?
- **Why one company has two tracks with almost the same name.** For example, Mor has "מניות" (12537) and "מניות סחיר" (15256).
- **"123 מקור 123 מחושב"** near the top.

## 6. What I wanted to know and couldn't find

- **Which track suits someone my age**, or how much risk each one carries.
- **How much a track lost in a bad year.** If 2022 was bad, how bad was it for my money? Averages hide that.
- **What happens at 60 and over.** I've heard this kind of fund has a tax benefit if you take it as a monthly pension. Nothing here.
- **Tax on withdrawal**, how long until I can take the money out, and whether there's a minimum deposit.
- **Whether I can bargain the fee down**, or if 0.58% is just what others paid.
- **Can I move to another company or track later**, and at what cost?
- **How to actually join**: a phone number or link for each company.
- **Is my money safe if the company has trouble?**
- **The return for the last year**, not only 3 and 5 years.

## 7. If half the page had to go, what goes first

1. **The Ayalon block** and every other row marked "חדש", "עוד לא דווח" or "0 מיליון ₪". They're useless to me.
2. **The coloured rings.** The percentages beside them say the same thing.
3. **The "קופה" numbers column.**
4. **The "מההפקדות" line.** It's almost always 0%, so maybe show it only where it isn't.
5. **"123 מקור 123 מחושב"** at the top.
6. **The product buttons for other products.** I came for one thing.
7. **The religious-track labels** ("הלכה יהודית", "הלכה איסלאמית"), unless you need them.

What must stay: the fee, the stock percentage, the 5-year return, the company size, and the sentence about past returns, which I'd move to the top.
